The occlusion corridor is sized entirely from this number, so an unclamped value would either leave the ship hidden or dissolve the world in front of it. Check the vessel's hull renderers (a stray oversized mesh, or a mis-scaled model), or widen the band if the hull really is this size. Docs/PRISM_ANIMATION.md §4.7.
